spans.text: Focus on what users are trying to accomplish, not features.
spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes user agency through its UX design principles. It emphasizes user control and freedom, progressive disclosure, error prevention, and user-centered design. Nielsen's heuristic 'User control and freedom: Easy to undo, escape, go back' explicitly supports user agency. The overall philosophy is centered on empowering users rather than manipulating them.

spans.note: The prompt explicitly includes accessibility considerations throughout, referencing WCAG guidelines (Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust) and consistently mentioning accessibility in wireframe annotations, screen specifications, and the heuristics checklist. This demonstrates a commitment to inclusive design that serves all users regardless of ability.
